Read the '[mem] GPU memory recoveries' line at each report and its '[mem] NOTE' line: with 0 recoveries in d1 the pools never ran dry, and this run must show the same 0 (nothing to compare). If d1 shows recoveries, compare the 'stopped ... ms in all' and 'longest' figures here against d1 and look for [hitch] lines and a missing goalie or goal-scene texture at the same frames.
